name: canopy
description: A self-updating study library: add a folder, run one script, it shows up on the page.

scripts.serve: node -e "console.log('Serving frontend/ on http://localhost:8080 (Ctrl+C to stop)')" && python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory frontend
scripts.verify: npm run validate && npm run check && npm run lint && npm test
